content_sections.heading: DVC Overman Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: DVC has announced vacancies for the post of Overman on a contractual basis. The category-wise vacancy details are mentioned below: The vacancy distribution includes UR, OBC, SC, ST and EWS categories as mentioned in the official notification.

rows.date: To be notified later on DVC website

content_sections.heading: DVC Overman Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for DVC Overman Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification and experience requirements mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must have: Diploma in Mining Engineering from a recognized institute. Valid Overman's Certificate of Competency issued by DGMS for Coal under CMR 2017/CMR 1957. Valid First Aid Certificate from any institute/organisation recognized by DGMS. Candidates should have a minimum of three years of post-qualification working experience in open cast coal mines as Overman. The maximum age limit for candidates applying for DVC Overman Recruitment 2026 is 55 years as on the closing date of online application. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: DVC Overman Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates selected for the DVC Overman Recruitment 2026 will receive a monthly consolidated pay of ₹45,000/- . The engagement is purely contractual and the selected candidates will not be entitled to regular absorption in DVC in the future.

content_sections.heading: DVC Overman Contract Period 2026
content_sections.text: The initial appointment period for DVC Overman posts will be 5 years . The contract may be extended for another 2 years based on performance evaluation and management approval. The performance of selected candidates will be reviewed annually. Extension of the contract will be considered after yearly performance evaluation. The appointment is purely on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: DVC Overman Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for DVC Overman Recruitment 2026 will be based on Interview / Skill Test . However, DVC management reserves the right to conduct additional screening tests, trade tests, skill tests or other assessments if required. Interview Skill Test Additional Screening / Trade Test (if decided by DVC)

content_sections.heading: DVC Overman Recruitment 2026 Place of Posting
content_sections.text: The selected candidates may be posted at any field formation, coal mines or joint venture locations of Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DVC Overman Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online only through the official DVC website. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted. Visit the official DVC website. Go to Career → Recruitment → Recruitment Notices . Open the DVC Overman Recruitment 2026 notification and apply online. Fill in all required personal, educational and professional details. Upload the required documents, photograph and signature. Preview the application form and verify all details. Submit the application form and keep a printout for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DVC Overman Online Application
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready before applying online: Recent passport-size photograph Signature Class 10th certificate Class 12th certificate and marksheet Diploma in Mining Engineering certificate and marksheet DGMS Overman's Certificate of Competency Valid First Aid Certificate Experience Certificate Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS), if applicable Identity Proof

content_sections.heading: DVC Overman Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Candidates must ensure that they fulfil all eligibility conditions before applying. Incomplete applications will be rejected. After final submission, changes in submitted application details will not be accepted. Candidates must bring original documents and self-attested copies during document verification/interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is DVC Overman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DVC Overman Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Damodar Valley Corporation for engaging experienced professionals as Overman on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DVC Overman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 9 Overman vacancies have been announced under DVC Overman Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for DVC Overman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Diploma in Mining Engineering along with a valid DGMS Overman's Certificate of Competency for Coal and a valid First Aid Certificate recognized by DGMS.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DVC Overman Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 55 years as on the closing date of online application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of DVC Overman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly pay of ₹45,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for DVC Overman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 21 September 2026 up to 23:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for DVC Overman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official DVC website under Career → Recruitment → Recruitment Notices.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DVC Overman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Interview / Skill Test. DVC may conduct additional screening or trade tests if required.
